framework: Autonomous-readiness criteria for SDL instrument interfaces

NA.label: N/A
NA.note: Excluded from the denominator. Allowed only for C5, C19, C21.

critical.question: Can the instrument be controlled programmatically and contractually at all?

important.question: Does the interface support robust autonomous operation?

cell_integration.question: Can the instrument participate in robotic workcells? (cell-deployed only)

decisionOrder.name: precondition
decisionOrder.rule: All cybersecurity/IT deliverables supplied (or isolated link formally accepted, or local control surfaces documented). Otherwise status = blocked.

decisionOrder.name: critical_floor
decisionOrder.rule: No Critical criterion may Fail; at most one may be Partial, and only with a written remediation commitment and a target date ≤ 12 months.

decisionOrder.name: important_floor
decisionOrder.rule: Failed Important criteria may total at most 4 weighted points; each Important Fail needs a documented gap-acceptance decision. Conditional floors: C7 ≥ Partial for hazardous/resource-blocking instruments; C15 ≠ Fail for unattended hazardous instruments unless a documented external mechanism (cell-level watchdog, hardwired interlock, supervisory power cutoff, orchestrator-side handling) is recorded. C17 Partial requires a reason code.

decisionOrder.name: cell_floor
decisionOrder.rule: Cell-deployed only: C19 ≥ Partial where a machine loads labware (a Fail disqualifies; no mitigation exception); optional buyer-defined local floors on C20/C21.

decisionOrder.name: weighted_total
decisionOrder.rule: Σ grade × weight over applicable criteria. Used only to rank instruments that cleared steps 1–4.

statuses.conditionally_eligible: Floors met, but a commitment or gap-acceptance is missing

special: C21: if sub-test (a) is verified only by fallback evidence (and is not N/A), a Pass counts as Partial.
C1: a Pass via a third-party gateway is an accepted mitigation, not vendor compliance.
Weights are proposed defaults; deployments may tune them. The API reports default-weight results.
preconditionDeliverables: Transport-encryption posture (risk-acceptance procedure documented for explicitly isolated networks)
Certificate and key lifecycle and rotation procedures
Published security-update policy with target patch intervals
rfpEvidencePack: Description of recovery behaviour after communication loss or process restart
